title: Stock recommendations for August 14
summary: Market experts and platforms have released their stock recommendations for August 14. MarketSmith India and financial expert Raja Venkatraman have provided their top stock picks for the day. BusinessLine also published its stock recommendation for August 14, 2026.
summary_points: MarketSmith India has issued stock recommendations for August 14.
Financial expert Raja Venkatraman has shared his top stock picks for August 14.
The Hindu BusinessLine published its stock recommendation for August 14, 2026.

summary_points_hi: मार्केटस्मिथ इंडिया ने 14 अगस्त के लिए स्टॉक सिफ़ारिशें जारी की हैं।
वित्तीय विशेषज्ञ राजा वेंकटरमन ने 14 अगस्त के लिए अपने शीर्ष स्टॉक पिक्स साझा किए हैं।
द हिंदू बिजनेसलाइन ने 14 अगस्त, 2026 के लिए अपनी स्टॉक सिफ़ारिश प्रकाशित की।
